passages.text: “A pot without a stand is easy to overturn, but if it has a stand it’s hard to overturn. In the same way, a mind without a stand is easy to overturn, but if it has a stand it’s hard to overturn.
passages.note: Feeling unsteady; a mind needs a firm footing

passages.text: “Few are those among humans who cross to the far shore. The rest just run around on the near shore.
passages.note: Busyness without progress; few truly change

passages.text: “Mendicants, the dawn is the forerunner and harbinger of the sunrise. In the same way good friendship is the forerunner and harbinger of the noble eightfold path for a mendicant.
passages.note: Good friends as the start of growth
